name: AI-PROMPT-sfx-9758719efaae
annotation:
Player revolver SFX with harbor room tone

Single-shot revolver SFX for a 1930s navy officer's sidearm in a top-down survival game. Dry crack with mid-forward punch, short metallic cylinder-spin tail, subtle low thump; slightly wet with harbor reverb (small room, stone walls). Must remain crisp when fired 6-8 times per second in bursts. No sci-fi layers, no modern suppressor character. Deliver 48 kHz WAV, 0.8-1.2 s, plus a quieter 20% distant variant.
